contract.note: Recurring factual errors in contemporary general-purpose models fairly operationalize the actual statement. The contract does not require universal failure or impossibility of improvement.

evidence.note: OpenAI's dated company disclosure reports remaining factual errors alongside improvements in GPT-5.4 versus GPT-5.2. The selected error-report prompts and relative rates limit generalization; this is not an independent finding.

reviews.rationale: The company evaluation supports the actual observation that contemporary LLMs retain a tendency to produce factual errors. Reported improvement is compatible with that observation. It establishes neither everyday error prevalence nor the stronger inherent unreliability added by the normalization.
